# Aquatic Dreams Swim

> Modesto, CA swim lesson destination for ages 3–12. 5-level Starfish Aquatics curriculum with a maximum of 3 students per instructor. Group, semi-private, and private lessons.

Located at 1212 Kansas Ave, Modesto, CA 95351. Phone (209) 577-3483. Email info@aquaticdreamsswim.com.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview of the swim program, levels, pricing, and family testimonials.
- [Swim Lessons](/swim-lessons): All 5 color-coded levels (White, Red, Yellow, Blue, Green), pricing, and weekly schedule.
- [Enroll](/swim-enrollment): Step-by-step swim lesson enrollment with assessment, session pick, waivers, and checkout.
- [Careers](/careers): Open positions and job application form for swim instructors and staff.
